GPN - Malawi - Updating of Feasibility Studies and Preparation of Detailed Designs for Water Supply Improvement in Mzuzu City Project
30-May-2025
The principal objectives of this project are to contribute to improved health, productivity and economy of the communities in Mzuzu City, and surrounding areas, by increasing access to safe, sustainable water supply services through the development of a new water source and the construction of a water supply infrastructure including a water treatment plant.
